transcription: Main article text only (site header, 'Skip Navigation' line, topic sidebar, the hidden 'Page Last Revised - November 22, 2021' line, the other-topics-in-series block and footer removed). The page's equations are GIF formula images; each is replaced by its own alt text verbatim ('1 divided by the square root of n(n-1)' etc.), and the line breaks inside those paragraphs are kept as line breaks. The embedded quotation of Article 1, Section 2 of the U.S. Constitution kept as part of the agency text. Straight quotation marks around 'priority' and 'multiplier' kept as printed. Whitespace normalised.
purpose: library: congressional apportionment by the Method of Equal Proportions — a stated multiplier formula (1 divided by the square root of n(n-1), from the formula images' alt text) with worked multipliers for seats two, three and four (0.70710678, 0.40824829, 0.288675134) and a step-by-step seat-assignment procedure for the 435 House seats. Fits step ordering (the apportionment procedure), quiz cards with predict-then-reveal on the worked multipliers, and the formula explorer for the multiplier/priority value.
